info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Rendition item API

items.docs: Save the rendition item data with an attached file. The request should be of type multipart/form-data. There should be a single file-part included with the binary value of the content item.

All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of rendition items, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long.

params.name: id
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given id.

params.name: contentItemId
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given content item id.

params.name: contentItemIdLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a content item id like the given value.

params.name: contentItemName
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given content item name.

params.name: contentItemNameLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a content item name like the given value.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given name.

params.name: nameLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a name like the given value.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given mime type.

params.name: mimeTypeLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a mime type like the given value.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given task id.

params.name: taskIdLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a task like the given value.

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given process instance id.

params.name: processInstanceIdLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a process instance like the given value.

params.name: scopeId
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given scopeId. When this is used then scopeType must also be set.

params.name: scopeIdLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a scopeId like the given value. When this is used then scopeType must also be set.

params.name: scopeType
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given scopeType.

params.name: contentStoreId
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given rendition store id.

params.name: contentStoreIdLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a rendition store id like the given value.

params.name: contentStoreName
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given rendition store name.

params.name: contentStoreNameLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a rendition store name like the given value.

params.name: contentAvailable
params.description: Only return rendition items with or without rendition available.

params.name: contentSize
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given rendition size.

params.name: minimumContentSize
params.description: Only return rendition items with the a minimum rendition size of the given value.

params.name: maximumContentSize
params.description: Only return rendition items with the a maximum rendition size of the given value.

params.name: createdOn
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given create date.

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Only return rendition items before given create date.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Only return rendition items after given create date.

params.name: lastModifiedOn
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given last modified date.

params.name: lastModifiedBefore
params.description: Only return rendition items before given last modified date.

params.name: lastModifiedAfter
params.description: Only return rendition items after given last modified date.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return rendition items with the given tenantId.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return rendition items with a tenantId like the given value.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns rendition items without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

info.name: Get the data of a content item

params.name: download
params.description: Explicitly request the content to be downloaded or viewed in a browser. By default it would be done based on the content media type

items.docs: The response body contains the binary content. By default, the content-type of the response is set to application/octet-stream unless the content item type contains a valid mime type.

info.name: Get the latest data of a rendition item

params.name: download
params.description: Explicitly request the content to be downloaded or viewed in a browser. By default it would be done based on the content media type

items.docs: The response body contains the binary content. By default, the content-type of the response is set to application/octet-stream unless the content item type contains a valid mime type.
